title: An explicit Frobenius corollary of established marginal entropy bounds for permanents
accepted_scope: For every nonnegative row-stochastic n×n A, per(A)≤exp(-n+e^4Σa_ij² log(e/a_ij))≤exp(-n+e^4 S(1+log n)). Fixed S≤γ yields polynomial-times-e^-n; source van der Waerden lower bound completes the doubly stochastic target.
limitations: No original asymptotic-target gap asserted. Pure-power bound is excluded at n=1; an all-n prefactor is supplied. Priority remains unresolved; Anari–Rezaei entropy inequality is credited, and scalar KL absorption/Frobenius consequence is the candidate contribution.
